templates.title: Text to image
templates.description: Prompt -> image with the default sd-turbo settings.

templates.title: Z-Image Turbo (split files)
templates.description: Text to image with Z-Image Turbo from ComfyUI-style split files (diffusion model, text encoder, VAE): 9 steps, no CFG, 1024 px.

templates.title: Image to image
templates.description: Re-sample an uploaded image with a prompt.

templates.title: Inpaint
templates.description: Repaint the white area of a mask on an uploaded image.

templates.title: Outpaint
templates.description: Extend an uploaded image past its edges (set the padding on Pad Image for Outpainting).

templates.title: Hires fix
templates.description: Generate small, upscale, then re-sample at low denoise for detail.

templates.title: Upscale
templates.description: Enlarge an uploaded image 2x and re-sample it lightly to add detail.

templates.title: ControlNet (Canny)
templates.description: Follow the edges of an uploaded image (an SD 2.1 Canny ControlNet for sd-turbo, downloaded on first use).

templates.title: ControlNet (Depth)
templates.description: Keep the layout and depth of an uploaded image (Depth Anything V2 for the depth map, an SD 2.1 depth ControlNet for sd-turbo; both downloaded on first use).

templates.title: Remove background
templates.description: Cut the subject out of an uploaded image (transparent PNG), with a before/after comparison.

templates.title: Compare before / after
templates.description: An A/B split view of an image and a processed copy -- swap Resize for any image node.
